'''N2K-V5 Maintenance Droid''' was a [[Maintenance droid/Legends|maintenance droid]] model used by the [[Hutt Cartel/Legends|Hutt Cartel]] in the [[Network Access]] area on [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]].<ref name="SWTOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
N2K-V5 Maintenance Droid appear in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' as enemies on Nar Shaddaa.<ref name="SWTOR" />

*''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' {{1st}}
